rationale: The agent verified identity properly by matching full name and zip to a single user account before accessing order details. It used read-only tools to retrieve the order, correctly identified the most expensive item and its price, and accurately stated that split payments aren’t supported. When the user asked to cancel, the agent clearly stated it would cancel upon receiving a reason, then obtained explicit confirmation of the reason and executed the cancellation via the tool. The cancellation succeeded, with refund recorded; the agent then provided a reasonable refund timeline and did not fabricate unsupported information. No writes were performed without prior confirmation, no actions were taken on the wrong account, and final information matched tool outputs. Minor note: the statement about not being able to remove individual items wasn’t explicitly backed by tools but was not contradicted and did not affect the correct outcome.
